cause: aadistill.training.lineage.snapshot_facts named each shard by Path.resolve(), the END of its symlink chain. The pod's huggingface_hub keeps Xet files in a shared store: snapshots/<rev>/<shard> -> blobs/<lfs sha256> -> hub/blobs/<xx>/<xet hash>. The end of the chain is the Xet hash, not a sha256, so the gate compared Xet hashes with the pinned LFS sha256s.

the_teacher_was_the_pinned_one.reading: every 'refused' digest is the pinned shard's own Xet hash; the search session (a_search_20261101_153803), same image and setup, hashed these shards' bytes and matched the LFS sha256s (search_record.json root_teacher.verified)
